description: FitLogr AI photo calorie estimator benchmark covering meals (Google Research Nutrition5k lab-weighed dishes), cardio workout consoles (CC-licensed Flickr displays), hard-negative ignores (CC-licensed Wikimedia Commons & Flickr), and David's 4 original repository fixtures.
policy_notes: Split isolation: Nutrition5k dev meals come exclusively from official rgb_train and test meals exclusively from official rgb_test (zero plate overlap). Workout consoles and hard-negative ignores are stratified across dev and held-out test with zero image reuse.
Zero-calorie plain drinks: plain water and plain black coffee without milk, cream, sugar, or accompanying food are labeled ignore (0 kcal).

Idle/non-calorie exercise consoles: powered-off consoles, quick-start/menu screens without active calorie readouts, lifetime distance summaries without calories, and gym equipment without readable displays are labeled ignore.

David's 2 meal fixtures (02-meal-kenzi-latte-pastry, 03-meal-banana-crepes) carry human visual_reference estimates rather than lab weights; all 26 dev/test meals are lab-weighed Nutrition5k ground truth with full macros.
